protocol.primary_prompt: 按阅读顺序逐行抄录图中可见文字，每行单独换行。看不清的字不要猜。只输出原文，不要解释或 Markdown。
protocol.decoding: Greedy decoding; temperature 0 where supported; no sampling.
protocol.scoring: Unicode NFKC, case folding and whitespace removal. Sentence punctuation and Latin letters are excluded; numeric and structured separators remain scored.
protocol.prediction_policy: No prediction imputation; provider refusals score as empty output.
protocol.rgs: RGS = P(退化图全对 | 同内容正常图全对)。使用所有 17 个模型均具备双侧预测的公共配对，并按同源组执行 2,000 次 bootstrap。
